paragraphs: Bar Tutni. Resh Lakish reports in his name: Shabbat 71a. Rashi explains that Tutni is a sage's name. In Keritut 4, beginning of side b: Resh Lakish in Bar Ta'utni's name; there, 12b, Tutini. In Hazit Rabbah, end of “His head is finest gold”: Bar Huta said, “Why is it called elef? Because it agrees from a thousand generations.” Mattenot Kehunah explains it as a sage's name. It seems to me a scribal error: it should read Tuta with tav, or Tutni.
